clauses.reason: The order establishes a defensive sea area around San Clemente Island, restricts navigation within it to craft authorized by the Secretary of the Navy and makes violators subject to legal penalties; it has no date or condition of its own that ends it. Executive Order 8536 (signed 1940-09-06) struck "three hundred yards" and inserted "one nautical mile" and added a sentence naming the area; Executive Order 9787 (signed 1946-10-05) restated the order to read as follows, with a three-hundred-yard extent except one hundred yards in Wilson Cove and including part of Pyramid Cove, and the same navigation and penalty paragraphs. Under the strike-and-insert ruling (research/readiness/owner_rulings/2026-10-21-strike-and-insert.md) the clause continues, amended, and the substance of the area changed with the restatement. Executive Order 9894, signed 1947-09-23 by Harry S. Truman, orders that the San Clemente Island Naval Defensive Sea Area, established by Executive Order No. 7747 as amended by Executive Orders No. 8536 and No. 9787, be discontinued; it takes effect on signing as it states no other date. State on 2026-10-14: terminated by express discontinuance on 1947-09-23.

research_rationale:
Executive Order 7747 of November 20, 1937 establishes the water around San Clemente Island, California, out to three hundred yards from low-water mark as a defensive sea area under section 44 of the Criminal Code (18 U.S.C. 96), restricts navigation within it to craft authorized by the Secretary of the Navy, and subjects violators to legal penalties. The held text is the Federal Register print as machine-extracted from the official PDF (2 FR 2947) with closing number [No. 7747]; the three paragraphs are one scheme and the dossier holds them as one clause. The order continued, as amended by Executive Order 8536 (1940-09-06, extent changed to one nautical mile and the area named) and restated by Executive Order 9787 (1946-10-05, restated to read as follows with changed extents), until Executive Order 9894, signed 1947-09-23, ordered that the San Clemente Island Naval Defensive Sea Area, established by 7747 as amended by 8536 and 9787, be discontinued. Amendments and the restatement are later events recorded with before-and-after text under the strike-and-insert ruling, not ends; the end is the express discontinuance. The packet's number-citation search lists the held later texts that name 7747 (8536, 9787 and 9894).
